hypothalamus_primary_FDR.rule: All primary hypothalamus BH q<0.05 genes, sorted by q then source symbol; no atlas restriction.

hypothalamus_measured_top10.rule: Ten lowest finite primary BH q among exact-symbol measured genes with finite MLE/SE/shrunken effects. Only primary q<0.05 is significant; remaining rows are exploratory.

cortex_primary_top20.rule: Twenty lowest primary BH q among protein-coding cortex genes with q<0.05, tie source symbol; no atlas restriction.

cortex_measured_top10.rule: Ten lowest primary BH q among q<0.05 cortex genes with exact Ensembl measured-panel matches and finite effects; includes noncoding genes.
